descriptor: Seed-Response Manifold Identifiability, Rank-Growth Scaling, Grassmann Subspace Stability, Held-Out Cell Transport & Finite-Seed Span Artifact Elimination

predecessor.key_result: Same-seed fingerprint replay and cross-archive identity survived, and fresh-seed fingerprints projected significantly into the P47 old-seed span. However, the training effect rank was 7 with only 8 centered seeds, exactly the algebraic maximum under row-centering.

theoretical_question: Does the seed-conditioned response geometry exhibit a stable low-dimensional core that persists as the number of prospectively sampled nominal seeds increases and across held-out representation cells, or was P48's low-dimensionality only the finite-seed rank ceiling?

seed_sets.authority: Seed integers are nominal labels; only membership in prospectively frozen sets is used.

cell_partition.universe: 64 cells = 32 vertices × valid/null using deterministic alias=ABCD[vertex_index mod 4].
cell_partition.selection_authority: Pure index rule frozen before P49 outcomes; no P48 effect-size selection.

archive_lanes.fresh_namespace: Exact P48 fresh isomorphic archive surface.
archive_lanes.purpose: Require any seed-response manifold claim to survive both seed growth and archive isomorphism.

rank_growth.object: For nested seed prefixes n∈{4,8,16,32}, compute centered seed×train-cell matrices separately for old and fresh namespaces.
rank_growth.rank_rule: Numerical rank from SVD tolerance max(shape)*eps*sigma_max; no post-hoc truncation.
rank_growth.comparison: Observed rank trajectory versus algebraic ceiling n-1.

energy_concentration.object: Freeze the n=8 training-cell PCA basis separately in each namespace. For future seeds 9..16 and 9..32, measure the fraction of centered train-cell energy captured by that frozen basis.
energy_concentration.null: 5000 random common cell-coordinate permutations of the frozen n=8 basis relative to future rows; one-sided for larger captured-energy fraction.
energy_concentration.meaning: Tests whether the early seed-response core continues to align with newly sampled seeds rather than exploiting the n=8 rank ceiling.

grassmann_stability.object: Compare the frozen n=8 basis against independently estimated top-k bases from disjoint seeds 9..16 and 17..32, where k=min(rank_n8,rank_block).
grassmann_stability.statistic: Mean squared singular values of B8·Bblock^T (average squared canonical correlation).
grassmann_stability.null: 5000 random common cell-coordinate permutations of the independent block basis.
grassmann_stability.meaning: Tests orientation stability using independent seed blocks, avoiding nested-sample self-overlap.

heldout_cell_transport.object: Use seeds 1..8 and 48 train cells to learn an n=8 PCA score system and least-squares mapping from seed scores to the 16 held-out cells. Freeze both. Predict held-out outcomes for seeds 9..16 and 9..32 from train-cell scores alone.
heldout_cell_transport.statistic: MSE improvement over the held-out-cell mean baseline learned only from seeds 1..8.
heldout_cell_transport.null: 5000 permutations of future seed-score rows relative to future held-out outcomes; one-sided for positive improvement.
heldout_cell_transport.meaning: Prospective representation-cell generalization: held-out-cell outcomes are never used to fit the frozen score→cell map.

primary_estimands.multiplicity: 12 inferential tests total (4 energy + 4 Grassmann + 4 held-out transport), one Holm FWER=0.05 family.

primary_verdict_logic.FINITE_SEED_SPAN_ARTIFACT: At n=32 rank reaches the centering ceiling in both namespaces and neither namespace passes all three test families at both horizons.
primary_verdict_logic.STABLE_LOW_RANK_CORE_WITH_STOCHASTIC_TAI: Rank continues to grow, but at least one namespace passes all energy, Grassmann, and held-out transport tests after Holm; both namespaces must pass for cross-archive authority.
primary_verdict_logic.SATURATING_SEED_RESPONSE_MANIFOLD: Both namespaces have rank_32 < 31 and rank_32 == rank_16, and both namespaces pass all energy, Grassmann, and held-out transport tests.
primary_verdict_logic.ARCHIVE_CONDITIONAL_MANIFOLD_ONLY: Exactly one namespace passes every inferential core/stability/held-out test.
primary_verdict_logic.NO_IDENTIFIABLE_SEED_MANIFOLD: Neither namespace passes every inferential core/stability/held-out test and rank behavior does not meet the finite-seed-span-artifact branch.
primary_verdict_logic.TECHNICAL_HOLD: Any of the 4096 required calls fails exact-schema evaluation.

secondary_outputs: Effective participation rank and entropy rank, descriptive only.
Cell loading maps over R/F/H/T/L representation vertices.
frozen_rules: No claim of a manifold is allowed solely because matrix rank < 64.
The n=8 rank ceiling problem from P48 is explicitly treated as a falsifier, not evidence.
Seed numbers are nominal labels; no regression on numeric seed value, distance, parity, or ordering.
No cell partition or SVD rank rule changes after outcomes.
A stable subspace is a behavioral response geometry, not a neural latent space.
Hosted provider/runtime and model identity remain confounded.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P49 alone.
harvest_linkage: XLVII: uniqueness burden — low rank must survive seed-growth falsification.
XLIX: branch geometry before compression — retain full singular spectra before any scalar summary.
MQR/CUBE-REV donor: quotient and representation invariance require transport beyond the coordinate system in which the structure was discovered.

novelty_kill_and_literature.known: Subspace comparison and principal-angle style representation analysis already exist in current LLM literature; P49 does not claim novelty for subspace metrics themselves.
novelty_kill_and_literature.missing_drive_candidate: Kim & Lee (2026), Same Benchmark, Same Subspace: Task-Selective Convergence in LLM Representations, UAI 2026 / PMLR 337.
novelty_kill_and_literature.p49_surviving_question: Whether an API-seed-conditioned behavioral response space remains stable under prospective seed-count growth and representation-cell holdout, after explicitly eliminating the centered-seed rank ceiling.
